summary: Vault human-centered improvements (Phase A-D) testing complete. All 17 features verified working correctly. Phase A: User-first language ('Your Documents' header, 'Add Document' dialog). Phase B: Category filters with counts, sorting by expiration. Phase C: Expiration badges (Active/green visible). Phase D: Replace flow with preselected category/type, prefilled metadata, 'Replace Document' title and button.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} - accessibility improvement needed

Phase A: Document count shows '16 documents' (active docs only)
Phase A: Empty vault message uses user-first language ('No documents yet', 'shared only when you choose')
Phase A: Upload dialog says 'Add Document' (not 'Upload to Vault')
Phase B: Category filters show count per category - All (16), Certification (2)
Phase B: Documents sorted by expiration (Active badges appear first, then no-expiration)

Phase D: Clicking Replace opens upload dialog with 'Replace Document' title

Archived toggle functionality (no archived documents exist)

action_items: LOW: Add aria-describedby to DialogContent components to fix accessibility warning
critical_code_review_comments: sortByExpiration function correctly handles: archived last, then expired, then expiring, then active, then no-expiration
expirationLabel function correctly returns: 'Expired' (red) for <=0 days, 'Xd left' (red) for <=30 days, 'Xd left' (amber) for <=60 days, 'Active' (green) for >60 days
startReplace correctly preselects category/type and prefills metadata from original document
handleUpload correctly archives old document via PUT /api/vault/documents/{id} with verification_status='archived'
activeDocs filter correctly excludes archived documents (verification_status !== 'archived')
Category filter counts correctly use activeDocs (not all docs)
